'''Yopno''' (Yupna, after the Yupna Valley) is one of the [[Finisterre languages]] of [[Papua New Guinea]]. Dialects are Kewieng, Nokopo, Wandabong, Isan. Yupno speakers orient themselves using local topography.<ref>{{Cite news|url=https://news.nationalgeographic.com/2016/04/160413-people-mind-bending-way-navigate-spatial-languages/?beta=true|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180620075718/https://news.nationalgeographic.com/2016/04/160413-people-mind-bending-way-navigate-spatial-languages/?beta=true|url-status=dead|archive-date=June 20, 2018|title=These People Have a Mind-Bending Way to Navigate|date=2016-04-13|access-date=2018-06-20}}</ref>
